sentences.text: The perusal of the statement of respondent No. 5 reveals that now he has no grievance against the petitioner, and, as such, has also sought withdrawal of all the case pending in any court of law.

5. Since the parties have settled the dispute amicably and that too with regard to certain business transactions, as such, the continuance of the investigation in FIR impugned shall be nothing but an abuse of process of law.
6. Viewed thus, the FIR No. 35/2022 for the commission of offences under section 420 & 506 IPC registered with P/S Uri at the instance of respondent No. 5 is quashed.
7. Accordingly, the petition is disposed of.

(Rajnesh Oswal) Judge SRINAGAR:
12.09.2024 "S.Nuzhat"
